name: explicit-content-after-chunk-fatal
description: the two spellings do not mix within one item: an explicit TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT carrying the id a chunk stream is assembling is not a continuation of it. It ends the shorthand, so the message's end is synthesized, and is then judged by the triad rules, where it names a message that is not open and is fatal. What the chunk delivered is kept. Local to this repository: the specification states the rule and the upstream corpus has no stream for it
kill: let an explicit event for the id a chunk stream is assembling join that stream instead of ending it
